ITEM 1 | Whole green-yellow pear-shaped fruit with mottled light green to yellowish skin, a few brown speckles and blemishes, small dark stem end at top, smooth matte-to-slight-sheen skin, firm and intact, roughly 8 cm long by 7 cm wide, sitting at the upper left of the plate with no cut surfaces | 180

ITEM 2 | Sliced fresh strawberries, bright red with lighter white-pink interiors and small seed dots on the cut faces, glossy and moist-looking, cut lengthwise into wedge and half-slice pieces about 2 to 4 cm long, clustered at the upper right of the plate | 120

ITEM 3 | Whole raw almonds, tan-brown with a matte, slightly fuzzy-looking papery skin and ridged teardrop shapes about 2 to 2.5 cm long, dry and firm, not oily, loosely piled in a cluster at the center of the plate between the pear and the orange | 60

ITEM 4 | Whole small orange citrus fruit, bright orange with a dimpled peel texture and a small stem scar at the top, about 5 to 6 cm in diameter, firm and round, sitting at the lower right of the plate beside the almonds | 110
